additional_info.subject: RE: ID0409382-DC/Si-D/NL-[MP / S3 170003392] Vehicle integration test CRM:00642002073
additional_info.body:
FYI.
In the attached mail there is some minutes of meeting for the next steps and time schedule.
There is no immediate action item.
Next information/steps will follow on Monday.
Here an extract on the time schedule:
Hencon will take care of the electrical connection of the charger. This should be finished by Monday (March 3
rd
)
Monday afternoon Hencon will switch on the charger and inform the Siemens team.
Siemens will be able to check remote connectivity of the charger and its status.
Based on that Siemens can evaluate if an onsite visit by Siemens field engineer is necessary to complete commissioning or if it can be completed remotely.
Important note:
The electric connection has a power limitation of 40kW (64A current). At the moment the charger is
not
limited in power. Charging before the limitation is set up in the charger will cause overload on the electric connection.
Assuming the happy flow of commissioning completed remotely and no Siemens onsite activity needed: Testing shall be performed Thursday morning (6
th
March 2025, starting at 9 AM CET).
After Monday afternoon , we will know if onsite commissioning support is required. If so, Siemens will align with local service team to find a fitting time slot. Most likely the following vehicle interop tests would be postponed and later than 6
th
March.
Many thanks and BR
Patrick
